notes: Direct HTTPS fetch, no WAF, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow (Shopify + Searchspring, same as prior Home-Decor pass on this site). Desktop mega-menu (homepage HTML) and mobile nav both expose exactly ONE pet-related node: 'Pet Accessories' -> /collections/pets, sitting as a plain leaf link (no submenu) alongside Blankets & Pillows / Mirrors in a Decor menu column. No /pages/pets, /pages/pet-accessories or similar curated landing page exists (all 404). The PLP itself (title 'Modern Pet Accessories | Designer Pet Bowls, Beds & More | 2Modern') renders 0 items server-side (client-rendered via Searchspring, siteId dja4ih, same pattern as the prior pass) and exposes only generic facets (Color, Material, Brand, Features, Price) - no Dog/Cat/Type facet for further on-page navigation. QTY: bgfilter.collection_handle=pets against dja4ih.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json returned pagination.totalResults=105; exhaustion-checked by paging resultsPerPage=100 across both pages (100+5) and counting distinct /products/ hrefs = 105 distinct, matching totalResults exactly. ABSENCE-PROOF / DEEPER STRUCTURE CHECK: sitemap_collections_1.xml and _2.xml were pulled and grepped for pet|/dog|/cat, revealing ~27 additional dog-/cat- prefixed collection handles (e.g. dog-beds=34, dog-walking=30, dog-leashes=14, dog-collars=14, cat-accessories=7, cat-furniture=3, several singleton 1-count and several 0-count handles) that verify as real, non-facet-re-cut, hierarchically-nested product sets (confirmed via product-ID overlap analysis: e.g. dog-beds(34)+dog-crate-mats(1) together account for all 35 of dog-sleeping; dog-accessories(19) contains dog-bowls(16)+dog-clothing(1); dog-walking(30) contains leashes/collars/harnesses/walking-accessories with some cross-tagging). However these are NOT reachable from the mega-menu, the mobile nav, the collection's own facets, or any /pages landing page - only 6 of the ~27 appear in a generic SEO 'Related Searches' footer block on the /collections/pets PLP itself, and several are 0-product or 1-product tag pages (dog-crates=0, dog-toys=0, cat-walking=0, cat-leashes=0, cat-collars=0, cat-clothing=0, cat-carriers=0, pet-accessories-other=0), consistent with auto-generated tag-based SEO pages rather than a merchandised category tree the site presents to shoppers. Two of the handles (pendleton-pets=14, boo-oh-pets=10) are brand collections (Pendleton Pets, Boo'Oh Pets brands, both present in the Searchspring 'brand' facet) which the prior Home-Decor pass on this exact site established should be excluded as brand roll-ups, not genuine categories; pets-on-sale=9 is a Sale roll-up, also excluded per the brief. Given none of the granular dog-/cat- collections are exposed through genuine site navigation, mega-menu, on-page facets, or a curated landing page - and per the brief's rule that navigation/marketing structure, not sitemap mining, defines a category - only the single nav-verified node is emitted. Nothing else pet-related found in footer or elsewhere on the site.
